_comment: Legacy Arabic SHX fonts (xarb.shx, xarab.shx) store text as ASCII key codes that the font draws as Arabic glyphs. The real codes cannot be recovered from the DXF alone, so `mappings` is intentionally EMPTY and every such string is reported readable=false. Fill `mappings` (one character -> Unicode string) only after the owner confirms the table against the font; the decoder then decodes a string only when EVERY character is either a digit/space or in `mappings`. See `candidates` for the evidence gathered from the three Qalyub drawings (not applied).

candidates.evidence: Lowercase keys follow the Windows Arabic 101 keyboard layout in logical order: lrhfv = مقابر, ,vam = ورشة, lk,v = منور, fb' = بلط, fg,; 5 = بلوك 5, ahvU = شارع. Upper-case and punctuation keys select other glyph forms (e.g. U = ع, H = ا, F/D/K/M/L = final forms) and are not derivable from the data.
